integrity: Proof specifies finite coverage and deterministic verification with a modulus whose rank computations agree with rational ranks; independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only five-point supports on binary vector spaces. An exact finite linear-algebra enumeration proves the two base cases; no claim about general sparse functions or all Fourier zero-set geometries.
title: Five-sparse Walsh support spectra stratified by affine rank on \(\mathbb F_2^d\)
